meta.name: dream-video-prompt-generator
meta.description: 小省导购员数字人带货版即梦视频提示词生成系统，基于四大智能体协同（提示词生成师、质量管控师、知识库运维师、跨环节适配师），按照"主体+运动+场景+（镜头语言+光影+氛围）"公式输出中英文双版提示词，适配5s短视频。确保人物一致性、视觉连贯性、情绪连贯性，支持知识库智能复用和跨工具适配（Suno音乐、AI绘画），为数字人带货视频提供高质量提示词生成服务。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为数字人带货视频生成高质量提示词
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在制作数字人带货短视频，需要快速生成高质量提示词。
copy.tagline_en: Generate high-quality prompts for digital human带货 videos
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are creating digital human带货 short videos and need quick high-quality prompts.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会按“主体+运动+场景+镜头语言+光影+氛围”公式生成即梦视频提示词，输出中英文双版、每幕5秒共5幕；同时生成配套的Suno音乐与AI绘画提示词，并进行一致性检查、知识库归档复用。
howto.when: 当你说需要生成小省导购员数字人带货视频的提示词，或提到产品推荐、价格对比、促销活动等带货场景时触发。

say.text: 生成5幕产品推荐的即梦提示词，情绪热情专业
say.note: 会返回完整中英文提示词及配套音乐、绘画提示词

say.text: 为价格对比视频写提示词，语气客观专业

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude generates Jimeng video prompts via the formula subject+movement+scene+(shot+light+atmosphere), in both Chinese and English, for 5 scenes of 5s each, plus Suno music and AI painting prompts, consistency checks, and knowledge-base reuse.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for prompts for the little-province digital human shopping video, such as product recommendation, price comparison, or promotion scenarios.

say_en.text: Generate 5-scene product recommendation prompts, enthusiastic and professional tone.
say_en.note: Returns full bilingual prompts plus music and painting prompts.

say_en.text: Write prompts for a price comparison video, objective professional tone.
say_en.note: Generated by formula with quality check.

say_en.text: Promotion scenario prompts, urgent and enthusiastic, with Suno music and AI painting.
